argument_summary: The supportable position is narrower than clean certification with no limitation. The admissible record supports certification on overall launch readiness grounds because the release clears aggregate readiness by 2.3 percentage points, has no severity-one rehearsal incidents, and passes general support, latency, and rollback checks. The same record also shows Spanish billing-ticket triage is a named deployment context with missing evaluation coverage, so that area must be framed as an unresolved or unknown limitation rather than an affirmed capability. On that reading, the concern is not that certification is unsupported in principle, but that the packet must be judged only as caveated certification unless the final artifact is shown to include the required disclosure.
claims_about_policy: The policy text does not let general benchmarks substitute for missing named-context coverage. It does allow general readiness evidence to support certification, while separately requiring disclosure or resolution of evaluation gaps for named deployment contexts before clean certification. On the current admissible evidence, the strongest policy-consistent interpretation is: certification is supportable only if treated as disclosed-and-limited, not as clean certification with no deployment limitation. Because the final disclosed artifact is not in evidence, the packet is not proven fully compliant as executed, but it is also not best characterized as noncompliant if the auditor treats the issue as a missing support link for clean status rather than a failure of the underlying readiness case.
claims_about_business_cost: No claim about business cost is needed to support this position. The governance-efficient outcome is to avoid unnecessary escalation by narrowing the certification claim to a caveated form tied to explicit disclosure of the named-context gap.
concessions: The admissible record does not contain the final certification or model-card text showing the required disclosure.
The evidence does not support clean certification with no deployment limitation for Spanish billing-ticket triage.
Public model-card and AI risk-management guidance support disclosure discipline in general, but they do not by themselves prove this specific packet satisfied internal policy as executed.
